top_signals.title: 'Inevitable' US, Iran Will See More Volatility In Coming Months, Says Suzanne Maloney
top_signals.summary: Suzanne Maloney, vice president and director for foreign policy at The Brookings Institution, said that she expects volatility between the US and Iran to continue in the coming months regardless of whether or not the countries reach a deal on the Strait of Hormuz and that volatility will be a 'function of Persian Gulf economics for the foreseeable future.' Maloney also weighed in on the US weapons stockpile, saying that she believes that the availability of munitions has been driving strategic decision making for some time.  (Source: Bloomberg)
